title: FAMS: Face Recognition Attendance System
description: FAMS Roll-Call Kiosk (desktop title: FAMS-Face Recognition Based Attendance Management System) face-recognition-attendance-system <https://github.com/Spidy20/Attendacemanagementsystem> Manual attendance registers are slow, easy to forge, and disconnected from the students who are actually present. Let an instructor register a student once, then mark attendance automatically from a webcam and produce a per-subject, per-timestamp CSV that can be archived or mirrored to a database. Classroom instructors / lab supervisors taking attendance; an administrator reviewing the enrolled-student register. Attendance/<Subject><YYYY-MM-DD><HH-MM-SS>.csv containing Enrollment,Name,Date,Time, optionally mir
problem_solved:
The original workflow is a paper register. The instructor calls names, ticks a box, and later re-types the sheet into a spreadsheet. Three problems follow:

1. **Time** — the register consumes the first minutes of every session.
2. **Integrity** — a hand-ticked sheet is trivially altered and cannot be audited.
3. **Fragmentation** — the data ends up in a format that cannot be queried, joined, or archived automatically.

A machine-vision attendance kiosk replaces the ticking with a webcam pass: enrolled faces are recognised automatically, and each session produces a machine-generated, timestamped record.

The honest scope of this repository: it is a **desktop application**, not a web service. There is no HTTP API, no server, and no multi-camera or multi-user design.
